text_block_list.text: —Summer. The season when all the Umamusume head to the training camp by bus, and yet...
This year, there was one Umamusume who boarded a plane all alone, bound for a whole new world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Listen closely, Taiki. Our long-cherished wish is entirely entrusted to you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! You can bounce back from any pressure! 
Have confidence in yourself and give it your all.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, Pearl-san!
I'll bring home an absolute victory for sure♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Yes! It's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: (I'm counting on you, Taiki. Yes, if it's you, whom I acknowledge from the bottom of my heart...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Trainer? What are you doing?
Shouldn't you cheer on Taiki too...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Where are you looking?
choice_data_list: The structure of the expedition team...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: An expedition team...? You mean Taiki's?

"The accompanying staff, the gear, it's all very informative.
Seeing the kind of setup Taiki Shuttle uses
when heading overseas."

The day will come when I can put these lessons to use.
Indeed, the path to the world stage has not been cut off.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're already gazing toward the distant future, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good, Trainer. Yes,
at the end of our detour, someday we too...

"The plane that Seeking the Pearl might just
have been on—took off into the sky, bound for France."

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Now, it's time for practice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
While Taiki's taking on the world,
we're gonna challenge a giant wall too!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the wall of speed! Even if I can't match
Taiki in overall ability—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: When it comes to speed, I will surpass Taiki this summer! Got that!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Then it's settled! This summer, I'll clear my goals
with elegance, and then—!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll be watching Taiki's world race in total comfort without a care in the world!
Ohohoho!

Yes, I didn't simply give up.
It's precisely because I didn't give up that I'm staying in Japan.

To achieve an even greater brilliance, this summer
the two of us must wager everything.
